stop_reason: AskCoworker Discovery call timed out twice (initial call and one retry with 'Restate your full answer.'). Per SKILL.md response-handling rule, stopped and reported. No spec was saved.

org_queries.purpose: Context: confirm target org is reachable (workflow step 1)

skill_friction: The timeout rule says 'stop and report' after one retry, but the skill also notes the service 'may keep working' and a later answer can begin with a 'Resuming from...' fragment. There is no guidance on waiting before the retry or on a later third attempt, so a transient timeout on Discovery ends the whole run.

SKILL.md does not say whether read-only org queries (workflow step 3) can still ground a partial or draft spec when AskCoworker is unavailable but the org is reachable. Here the org was connected, and describing Refund__c/Transaction__c could have produced useful grounding, but the stop rule blocks that.
The tool returned only 'The operation timed out.' with no elapsed time, so the seconds field could not be measured and is recorded as 0.
RUNNER.md's run.json has no field for 'validator not run'. validator_first_pass_ok=false with validator_attempts=0 is the closest fit.
